questions.question: Describe the environmental benefits of urban green spaces. (4 marks)

points.text: Urban green spaces mitigate the urban heat island effect - trees and vegetation cool cities through shade and evapotranspiration, reducing temperatures by 2-4°C (1 mark). They improve air quality by absorbing pollutants like NO₂ and particulate matter and producing oxygen (1 mark).
